title: Add unit tests for AgentSessionService
description:
PR #53 (memorysmith_agent_invoke, Phase 1+2) introduced AgentSessionService with scope intersection, session lifecycle/locking, idle expiry, tool filtering, and the embedded-lock pattern. No unit tests were included. This task tracks adding NUnit coverage.

### Acceptance criteria
- Session ownership enforcement: cross-principal resume returns NotFound (same error as not-found)
- Scope computation: tests for all 6 meaningful combinations (scope x profile x permission)
- Empty-scope guard: CreateSessionAsync returns Fail when ComputeEffectiveScopeAsync returns empty list
- Cleanup expiry: AgentSessionCleanupService acquires session lock before SetStatus, double-check pattern is correct
- Tool filter: InvokeCoreAsync filtered catalog uses AvailableInChat, not AvailableInMcp
- AgentTools property: returns AvailableInChat=true tools (not MCP-only)
- EndSessionAsync double-check: returns false (not throws) when session already expired/closed
